items.quote: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, “Seize him!”
items.contrast: King Jeroboam gives the order; the man of God is the person he orders seized.
items.reason: The alternative reading that Jeroboam orders himself seized is not plausible. “Him” refers to the man of God whose words provoked the king, and the next sentence confirms that the king stretched his hand toward that man. Resolving the pronoun’s referent is a concrete actor-versus-recipient distinction.
